title: James Madison University
description: James Madison University's official identity guidelines define the primary colours JMU Purple (#450084) and JMU Gold (#CBB677), and the secondary colours Medium Purple (#B599CE), Light Purple (#DACCE6), Dark Gold (#AD9C65), Light Gold (#F4EFE1), Slate Gray (#333333), Dark Gray (#595959), Medium Gray (#B2B2B2) and Light Gray (#F5F5F5).
